source_scope_notes: Accepted means technically valid; all scientific failures are retained.
Repeated physical runs share one frozen prediction per model/policy/window; pairs are not independent predictions.
Physical occupied intervals span launch to verified release; setup/cleanup primitives are retained but metrics clip to [0,2100].
Calibrated replay occupied intervals cover every non-off native state, including stopping; initial active devices have no window startup fee.
Starts are launch/starting events and stops are shutdown/stopping events; only times in [0,2100) enter window transition charges.
Prompts, source row identities, absolute clocks, process/host identities and machine paths are excluded by explicit projection.
Historical P1 permits up to 1% online deadline misses and requires all offline deadlines; P1plus requires all requests timely.

V3 prediction reference.P1 is null: its native feasible flag used the older 95% offline threshold, unlike the physical P1 100% offline threshold. P1plus is reconstructed from authoritative population counts; the native flag is not relabeled as P1.

Physical occupied intervals use launch to verified release with setup/cleanup retained. Replay intervals integrate all states other than off; initial active state is not a chargeable startup event.
Prices are scenario accounting coefficients, not observed API or cloud invoices. Synthetic API charges use input tokens and maximum output-token budgets.
Events use relative seconds only; prompt/output token IDs and process/host provenance are omitted. Request IDs are globally stable SHA256-derived aliases.
Physical policy decisions use scheduled window ticks and actually executed targets; associated lifecycle events retain their observed relative timestamps.
E2 agreement and cost MAE include 32 accepted cells (30 policy runs plus two all2 anchors); four failed technical attempts are excluded, twelve valid negative-result cells are retained.
The E2 prediction alias ppo_C30_selected and physical alias ppo_C30_raw identify the same archived checkpoint and tensor; exported policy names consistently use ppo_C30_raw.

E3 includes 26 accepted cells and no retries. Cost MAE uses 24 policy runs excluding two all2 anchors; screening confusion uses six arms. Recovery and steady windows ran on separate host allocations, so window and host are confounded.
SGLang deployments use the same contract and two selected windows. This is a backend-transfer case study, not a single-variable engine comparison.
All technically valid scientific failures are retained. Capacity anchors are released and paired but excluded from the frozen 24-cell comparison.
Repeats reuse one prediction per model/policy/window. Repeated comparisons are not independent frozen predictions.
Two excluded attempts missed a policy-tick deadline and were repeated unchanged. Their root cause is unresolved; this inventory does not assert environmental causality.
Model metadata documents the replay parameters; only startup_seconds differs among C, C30, and C_sg. The guard estimator is unchanged.
Relative timing and token budgets are preserved; source identities, prompt/response text, absolute clocks, paths, hosts, and device UUIDs are not exported.

scope: Contract-level paired traces from V3, Bridge, E2, E3, and E4; selected deployments with reused frozen predictions.
